claim: You can add a global secondary index to an existing table or delete it later, but local secondary indexes are created only when the table is created: you cannot add one to an existing table or delete an existing one.
question: Can you add a local secondary index to an existing table? What about a global secondary index?

values.display: add a new global secondary index to an existing table
values.spoken: a GSI can be added later

values.display: You cannot add a local secondary index to an existing table
values.spoken: an LSI cannot be added later
